title: Persistent worker threads of the TaskManager, started by exudyn.special.solver, sleeping between solves
author: Claude-JG
description: Every solver with numberOfThreads > 1 starts and stops its worker threads; for many runs of small systems this costs. A function of exudyn.special.solver starts a number of workers that stay, sleeping on a condition variable while no solver uses them; a solver whose simulationSettings.parallel.numberOfThreads agrees uses them, one that disagrees uses its own number for that solve and writes a message (simulationSettings wins).
releaseNotes: exu.special.solver.StartPersistentThreads(n) starts n threads that stay, sleeping while no computation uses them; every solver with parallel.numberOfThreads = n uses them instead of starting and stopping threads of its own, which saves 0.2-0.8 ms per solve; a solver with another number of threads uses that number for its run, with a warning; StopPersistentThreads() and PersistentThreads() stop and count them; the raytracer uses them alike.
